Its `lib: WebWorker` is mutually exclusive with the DOM lib above — pulling it into this program silently retypes globals like addEventListener for EVERY file (it broke the pull-to-refresh specs). Vitest still RUNS the test from here; the vitest `include` glob is independent of tsconfig.
